<span id="in-one-paragraph"></span>
== In one paragraph ==

Aither World is a family of small, single-purpose tools (about 70 “bricks”) for building and running AI agents on hardware you control. The core brick, [[Company Brain/awdk|awdk]], is a Python SDK and command-line tool for agents that run on your machines: a single agent or a fleet that delegates, with tools, persistent knowledge-graph memory, safety filtering and effort-based model routing.

<span id="why-it-matters-to-occupysaas"></span>
== Why it matters to OccupySaaS ==

Our method has AI agents implement from a written specification, with a human reviewing every merge (see [[How we develop]]). Aither World is the engine intended for that step.
